description:
Permanently removes a monitored website property and all of its stored banner configurations, GTM bindings, audit history, and cached legal documents from the active Paperloo registry.

When to use vs. related tools: Call 'delete_site' only when a site should be permanently decommissioned from monitoring. Use 'list_sites' or 'get_site' first to confirm the exact 'siteId'.

Preconditions & side effects: 'siteId' must match an existing site ID or exact URL/hostname in the registry. Destructive mutation—immediately deletes the matching site from 'activeSites'.

Returns: JSON object with 'success: true', deleted 'siteId', 'name', 'url', 'deleted_at', and 'message' (or 'success: false', 'error', and 'available_sites' if not found).

siteId.description: Registered site UUID or exact registered URL of the property to delete.

name: delete_site

outputSchema.description: Confirmation of deleted site or not-found error.

available_sites.description: Registered sites returned when siteId does not match.

items.description: Summary entry for a registered monitored website.

error.description: Lookup error message when success is false.

name.description: Display name of the removed site.

success.description: True if the matching site was deleted; false if siteId was not found.

url.description: Registered URL of the removed site.

title: Delete Monitored Website
